tensions: The board is unanimous on the holds and split on the posture. First, the playbook's stated buying power ($46.60) is off by roughly 25x from the broker's actual ($1.87) - any recommendation built on it was unexecutable before it was written; the position table should be re-synced. Deeper tension: the no-trim mandate and the zero-cash position are the same decision seen twice. Refusing to trim DOT (+31%) or ZEC (+26%) is what keeps buying power at zero, which is what makes the next opportunity unactionable. Coherent for a hold-for-100x thesis; incoherent for a scanner that runs daily hunting entries. Second: LINK is 34% of the book after the Sep 6 rotation and has returned 6.4% in ten days, while the positions harvested to fund it (UNI +109%) were the actual winners. Rotating from proven momentum into a laggard is a bet that has not paid yet.

opening.text: Book value $1,388.06 against $1,086 cost - up 27.8%. Eight names, seven green. The tape was risk-off at the index level: total cap -2.0% on the day, BTC $78,843, dominance 58.4% and holding. Alts gave ground. The book did not: DOT ripped +9.8% intraday to $1.1932 and now sits +31.4% above the $0.908 entry from four days ago, and ZEC added +2.8% to $1,182.96 for +26.0% in five days. Those two carried the day while LINK, LTC, AAVE and ADA each shed 1-3%.

The real finding is not a coin, it is the cash line. The playbook assumed roughly $46.60 of buying power. The broker reports $1.87. That is the whole story of this scan: there is nothing to deploy, so the seven-lens screen is academic - every buy candidate is a PASS by force, not by conviction. The Sep 6 rotation (UNI +109%, BTC +25%, ETH +29% harvested into LINK) consumed the powder. LINK is now the largest position at $474.72, roughly 34% of the book, and it is up only 6.4% in ten days. Concentration without payoff yet.

No sells. Nothing here has a broken thesis. NEAR is the only red name at -5.9% ($2.4534 to $2.3075) and it is two days old - that is noise, not signal. The line to watch is $2.20; a close under it means the entry was early and the Sep 6 timing was wrong. And no trims, per the mandate: DOT at +31% and ZEC at +26% are exactly the positions that get sold too early by people who confuse a profit with a top. Ride them.

Fear and Greed at 66 - Greed. That is the number that should make you cautious, not comfortable. Greed at 66 with BTC dominance climbing to 58.4% while total cap falls 2% is the signature of money hiding in BTC while retail stays optimistic in alts. That divergence usually resolves downward for alts. This book is 100% alt, zero BTC, and $1.87 in cash. No hedge, no dry powder. If the tape turns, the only available response is sitting still. That is the position - by design, but it deserves to be named honestly.
